OpenAI does not publish one fixed ChatGPT usage limit: it publishes plan, model, workspace, and reset rules, and this page adds the downloadable official-source table the top results do not provide.

Official wording: “Usage limits depend on your plan, the model” and workspace settings. Free and Go everyday text chats are unlimited, but uploads, images, voice, data analysis, deep research, reasoning, Pro models, Work, and Codex still have separate limits.

Related questions

ChatGPT limits

For broad ChatGPT limits, use the table above as the official baseline: normal text, reasoning, Pro models, tools, Work, Codex, and workspace controls are counted differently.

ChatGPT Plus limits

Plus has higher model limits than Free and costs $20/month, but OpenAI says Plus message caps may vary based on system conditions.

ChatGPT message limit

OpenAI does not publish one universal message limit for every account. When a reset is available, ChatGPT shows it in the product.

ChatGPT free limit

Free text chat is unlimited with GPT-5.6 Luna, while uploads, image generation, voice, deep research, memory and context, Codex, and ChatGPT Work are limited with no fixed public counts from OpenAI. OpenAI’s own pricing page says unlimited text chats are subject to abuse guardrails. So ChatGPT without limits only applies to everyday text chat, not every model or tool on the Free plan. For anything outside normal text chat, the official number is Not published.
